proof.text: For each component, choose a preimage using the assumed surjectivity. Assemble these preimages by the evaluation bijection for the source sheaf, then use naturality and injectivity of the target evaluation bijection to verify that the assembled section maps to the prescribed section.

title: Componentwise lifting on finite coproduct evaluations
statement: Given a simplicial object U over W and, in every degree, a finite family of component objects whose evaluation maps are bijective and on which every sheaf epimorphism evaluates surjectively, every sheaf epimorphism evaluates surjectively on U in that degree.

lean.statement: theorem weaklyContractible_of_components (X : Scheme.{u}) (W : X.ProEt) (U : SimplicialObject (Over W)) (hcomponents : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → X.ProEt) (maps : (i : I) → V i ⟶ (U.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).left), (∀ F : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (u + 1)), Function.Bijective (fun s : F.obj.obj (op (U.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).left) ↦ fun i ↦ F.obj.map (maps i).op s)) ∧ (∀ (i : I) (F G : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (f : F ⟶ G), Epi f → Function.Surjective (f.hom.app (op (V i))))) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (F G : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (f : F ⟶ G), Epi f → Function.Surjective (f.hom.app (op (U.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).left))
